text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — PR #9123 is failing CI. Two failing jobs: unit-tests (timeout on kv_cache_eviction_test) and snapshots (one mismatch). Can someone take a quick look? :eyes:
Priya Kapoor: On it, will check the logs now. Does this block the release?
Jon Rivera: I saw kv_cache_eviction_test flake earlier this week, usually timing-related when CI jobs get crowded. Could be a slow machine or a test that assumes ordering.
Maria Gomez: Snapshot mismatch looks like a whitespace change in the serialized plan, maybe unrelated. Pinging logs.
CI Bot: CI failed for PR 9123 — job: linux-unit (timeout), job: snapshot-update (1 diff). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/9123/logs
Alex Chen: If kv test is flaky we should rerun before updating snapshots. Don't want to commit a snapshot that hides a real bug.
Priya Kapoor: Agreed. Re-run suggestion: ``./scripts/ci/rerun_pr.sh 9123 --jobs linux-unit,snapshot-update``. Also locally you can run just the test: ``yarn test packages/runtime --testNamePattern="kv_cache_eviction_test" --runInBand``
Jon Rivera: If rerun reproduces the timeout consistently, we should add a small wait or increase the test timeout (not ideal). Otherwise, a single rerun and merge is fine.
Maria Gomez: I'll trigger a rerun now (using the rerun script). Will report back in ~5m. :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: Rerun results: linux-unit passed, snapshot-update still shows 1 diff. Snapshot diff is tiny (trailing space in plan string).
Priya Kapoor: Can you paste the `git diff` for the snapshot? If it's just formatting I can update snapshots in the PR.
Maria Gomez: ``diff --git a/tests/__snapshots__/plan.snap b/tests/__snapshots__/plan.snap
index 1234..2345 100644
--- a/tests/__snapshots__/plan.snap
+++ b/tests/__snapshots__/plan.snap
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-{"plan":"run\n"}
+{"plan":"run\n" }``
Alex Chen: Looks like an extra space before closing brace. Could be serializer change from the recent PR. Do we want to accept snapshot update or revert the serializer tweak?
Jon Rivera: If the PR intentionally changed serializer spacing, update snapshot. If not, revert the change. Quick check: does the PR touch serializer code? @Priya
Priya Kapoor: PR touches cache layer only, but the serializer change might be a side-effect of formatting lib bump in a deps update earlier. I'll run `git blame` to confirm.
Priya Kapoor: `git blame -- tests/plan_serializer.js` shows no changes in this PR. So the diff is probably from a transitive dep or test harness env. I'm ok updating snapshot here to unblock, but I'll add a follow-up issue to root-cause the formatting drift.
Alex Chen: Sounds good. Who can push the snapshot update? We need an approval after that. @Jon can you review the updated snapshot quickly?
Jon Rivera: Yep, I'll review once it's pushed. If tests pass on rerun and snapshot change is only whitespace, give me a :thumbsup: and I'll approve.
Priya Kapoor: Done — pushed snapshot update and restarted CI. Command I used: ``git checkout -b pr/9123-snap-update && yarn test -u && git commit -am "test: update snapshot for plan spacing" && git push origin pr/9123-snap-update``
CI Bot: CI passed for PR 9123 on rerun (linux-unit, snapshot-update).
Jon Rivera: Reviewed and approved. :rocket:
Alex Chen: Thanks all. Merging now. Note for follow-up: create an issue to track unexpected serializer formatting changes so we don't keep chasing whitespace diffs.
Priya Kapoor: I'll open the issue and tag infra + qa.
Maria Gomez: Nice quick turnaround.
Alex Chen: Great work, team.
